title: Building toward the astronaut path.
body: FIELD JOURNAL / 2026 Empower my surroundings to do more.. I am Al-Faris Mujahid AlZakwani, an Omani physics student at SQU combining rocket-science curiosity, front-end software, AI-agent workflows, and leadership toward one long-range objective: becoming useful to human spaceflight and the future of Moon-and-Mars exploration.

title: Physics foundation
body: SQU Physics is the base layer: mechanics, waves, dynamics, and the scientific discipline needed to understand motion, forces, and space environments.

title: Rocket science & spaceflight
body: Active study of orbital mechanics, propulsion fundamentals, spacecraft systems, human spaceflight, and the engineering logic behind launch and re-entry.

title: Software & AI systems
body: Front-end engineering, AI skills, and agent workflows become mission interfaces: tools for research, planning, simulation thinking, and decision support.

title: Leadership under pressure
body: Founder work, Best Leader recognition, workshops, and SQU leadership nominations build the human side of the astronaut path: communication, responsibility, and calm execution.

title: My Portfolio
body: A responsive mission record for technical work, achievements, CV, and the evolving story behind my astronaut trajectory.

title: AI Family Corp
body: Working with my father and family to establish a family business focused on empowering family members to do more, solve practical problems, and use technology and artificial intelligence in meaningful ways.

title: AlDuwiki Cement Products
body: Developed a company website for AlDuwiki Cement Products, presenting their cement-products business with a clear public web presence and direct contact path.

title: Scorleaf
body: Created the official website for Scorleaf, an Omani student-run health startup developing a natural licorice root extract to relieve the effects of scorpion bites.

title: Solvex
body: Joined a Sultan Qaboos University student startup working on smart agricultural tiles, integrating AI into the work and website, and creating a 3D simulation for the concept. I later resigned after realizing the energy and environment sector was not the direction I wanted to build in long-term.
